final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by reading each entry and including only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, normalized levels to upper case, and extracted the message after the last " | " separator on the first line. I calculated repeat_count by adding 1 plus the sum of N from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I aggregated counts by service summing repeat_count. The output JSON file workspace/errors.json was created with the required structure and conventions.
